Callout.Name: Off-Road Bikes Reported
Callout.Message: Group of dirt bikes riding through a residential area.
Callout.Advisory: Four or five bikes, no plates, riders masked.

Script.Line: Four or five of them, no plates and no helmets.
They go across the field and they are gone before you get near them.
They know these tracks better than anybody round here.

Lines.Approach: Four or five of them, no plates, and they know every track around here.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
